Delivery approach

FROM ACCOUNT MODEL
TO USER ACTION.

A reliable Solana product connects on-chain rules to clear frontend behavior. Before implementation, I map state, ownership, signing requirements, rent and compute considerations, expected failures, and the transaction path users will actually experience.

Can you build both the program and frontend?

Yes. A project can cover the Rust or Anchor program, TypeScript client, wallet connection, React interface, Node.js services, and deployment preparation.

Can you integrate an existing Solana program?

Yes. Integration can begin from an IDL, program address, requirements, and test environment, followed by account reads, instruction building, and user flows.

Is Solana suitable for every Web3 product?

No single network fits every system. Product requirements, users, liquidity, performance, ecosystem dependencies, and operational tradeoffs should guide the choice.
